tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and desktop ground behind windows.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Settings window and host-app window body.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Grouped settings rows, input fields, model and glossary cards.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, popups and the selected segment thumb.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Translucent settings sidebar over the window.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the translation itself.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: values, language chip, captions. 6:1 on window.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: stale translation, placeholders, phase labels. ≥4.4:1 on card and window.

tokens.name: fill-1
tokens.usage: Hover wash, tray cards, editable translation hover.

tokens.name: fill-2
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row, segmented track, keycaps.

tokens.name: fill-3
tokens.usage: Slider track, inactive progress dots.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline row separators inside groups.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Field outlines, menu separators, keycap bottom edge.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off.

tokens.name: accent-clay
tokens.usage: Default accent. The TypeLay colour: capsule dot, switches, focus.

tokens.name: accent-ocean
tokens.usage: Accent option.

tokens.name: accent-sage
tokens.usage: Accent option.

tokens.name: accent-iris
tokens.usage: Accent option.

tokens.name: accent-graphite
tokens.usage: Accent option for a colourless UI.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills only — switches, slider, progress, selection rings. Never body text (3:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, Resume, Edited label. 5.3:1 light, 6.1:1 dark on card.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, highlighted menu row, sent bubbles — white text on it is 4.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Focus halo, selected glossary row, badge ground.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Status dot: running, ready, connected.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Status dot and text: needs attention, conflict, failed update. 4.6:1 light.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Status dot: failed, disconnected. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Overlay, tray panel, menu bar — always with backdrop blur(28px) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, and every glass surface when Reduce transparency is on.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Inner 0.5px highlight that gives glass its lit rim.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Outer 0.5px edge separating glass from what is behind it.

tokens.name: shimmer
tokens.usage: Sweep highlight over a translation that is updating.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and the first-run window.

styles.name: translation
styles.sample: Could we go over the details tomorrow afternoon?
styles.usage: The translation in the overlay. Size is a user setting (13–19px); font follows the TARGET language.

styles.name: translation-cjk
styles.sample: 我们明天下午再聊细节，可以吗？
styles.usage: Same role for Chinese, Japanese and Korean targets — resolved by lang, not a separate token in code.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles that lead a group, window titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 登录时启动 Open at login
styles.usage: Every settings row label and value.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Status lines, progress meta, prototype controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in chips, segment padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; window inset of the floating sidebar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside tray cards; overlay inner padding (right).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; row horizontal padding is 14px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between onboarding blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between setting groups (18px) rounds up here at large sizes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Content bottom padding.

tokens.usage: Buttons, nav rows, search fields.

tokens.usage: Setting groups, menus, tray cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, preview canvases.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Expanded overlay panel; the capsule uses half its height.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Settings window, tray panel; first-run window 20px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsule, language chip, toast, composer field.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Groups, controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, preview field.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Windows, overlay, tray, menus.

tokens.name: dur-1
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-2
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes, overlay fade-out 160ms.

tokens.name: dur-3
tokens.usage: Page change, menus.

tokens.name: word-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between words as a translation appears; capped after 28 words.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tray, toggles, segment thumb — a small overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-word
tokens.usage: Word reveal: blur 7px → 0, rise 0.32em, 520ms.

tokens.name: spring-grow
tokens.usage: Stiffness and damping while the overlay grows — slight overshoot, feels alive.

tokens.name: spring-settle
tokens.usage: While the overlay shrinks back to the capsule — no wobble.

tokens.name: spring-appear
tokens.usage: Scale 0.9 → 1 when the overlay first appears at the field.
